topic: AgentOS next cadence: functional and experience improvements after TUI-oriented Alpha
decision: sequence experience primitives before broad capability expansion

features.name: Full-Screen Operator Shell
features.value: Turn the line-oriented TUI into a stable all-day operator console.
must_preserve: TUI does not own side effects

features.name: Live Projection And Event Model
features.value: Make TUI views update predictably from durable runtime state.
features.owner_boundary: RunStore + AuditJournal + active artifact state are truth

features.name: Approval And Recovery Workbench
features.value: Make high-risk decisions and crash recovery inspectable and hard to misuse.
features.owner_boundary: AgentCore owns lifecycle; SecurityExecutionEngine owns side effects

features.name: Operator Session And Profiles
features.value: Remember local operator context without turning preferences into authority.

features.name: Capability Library And Workflow Catalog
features.value: Expose AgentOS as a useful OS with discoverable operational capabilities.
features.owner_boundary: catalog is projection over AgentCore and AOM capabilities

features.name: Production Update And Fleet Readiness
features.value: Make update, rollback and release evidence operator-facing before fleet rollout.
features.owner_boundary: release/update authority remains scripted and audited
must_preserve: fleet remains later unless local proof passes

features.name: Observability And Support Console
features.value: Give operators one place for health, degraded state, audit evidence and support bundle workflow.
features.owner_boundary: support console projects existing support_bundle and audit sources

features.name: Ecosystem Governance And Trust UX
features.value: Make artifact trust, revocation, compatibility and activation risk understandable.
features.owner_boundary: AOM projection only; activation remains runtime-mediated
must_preserve: trust display is not policy authority
